newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Banerj tender document published.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Banerj tender document published.

text.p: The Rio de Janeiro state government has published the tender document for the privatization of state bank Banco do Estado do Rio de Janeiro (Banerj ) and its wholly-owned insurance subsidiary Banerj Seguros.
Banerj will be sold off at a closed-envelope privatization auction on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange December 17 and interested investors have until December 6 to pre-qualify.
The minimum price for Banerj is to be published at a later date, according to the head of Rio's privatization program Henrique Dittmar.

Paulo Ferraz, the president of private investment bank Bozano, Simonsen, which has been administering Banerj since January with the aim of cleaning up the bank's books ahead of privatization, said he was in favor of publishing the minimum price 48 hours before the auction.

The Rio state government is selling off 1,492,759,736 ordinary shares in Banerj or 99.97 percent of the bank's total capital, and 911,668 ordinary shares in Banerj Seguros or 100 percent minus one share of the insurer's total capital.

Seven financial institutions have so far pre-qualified for the Banerj privatization auction, Brazil's Bradesco, Itau and Companhia de Investimentos Latino Americana, France's CCF, Austria's BBA Creditanstalt and General Electric Capital Corporation of the United States.
The same seven institutions, plus health insurance company Golden Cross, have also prequalified for the privatization of Banerj Seguros.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
